item.title: Skupper workshop: Patient Portal on Kubernetes
item.description:
Description

This workshop introduces Red Hat Service Interconnect, an application integration solution that lets different systems communicate efficiently and securely.

Solution architecture

Service topology

Workshop outline

  1. Sign in to Red Hat Developer.
  2. Create an OpenShift cluster.
  3. Access the OpenShift cluster.
  4. In the Red Hat OpenShift Sandbox project, open your project.
  5. Create a virtual machine with OpenShift Virtualization.
  6. Install packages on the virtual machine:
    • podman
    • kubernetes-client
    • skupper
    • oc
    • wget
  7. Deploy the database with Podman.
  8. Deploy the application frontend and backend.
  9. Configure Service Interconnect (Skupper) so the database running under Podman can talk to the app on OpenShift.
  10. Access the application and confirm communication works.
  11. Closing notes.

Links

Resource Link
[1] Red Hat Developer https://developers.redhat.com/
[2] OC https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/4.15/cli_reference/openshift_cli/getting-started-cli.html
[3] Skupper https://skupper.io/

Prerequisites

  • A Red Hat Developer account
  • Basic Kubernetes knowledge
  • Basic Red Hat OpenShift knowledge
  • Basic Podman knowledge
  • Google Chrome preferred—it lets you paste commands into the VM console over browser VNC.

Step by step

1. Sign in to Red Hat Developer

Go to Red Hat Developer and sign in with your account.
